ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her feet to the top of her head completely visible, the surroundings at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
